headline: Santander Forecasts Argentina Commodity Exports Could Double by 2030
summary: Economists at Santander expect Argentine agriculture, energy, and mining export sales to double by 2030, citing fiscal balance improvements and lower inflation.
why: Banco Santander is one of Spain's largest global banking institutions and a major financial provider in Latin America.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Projections of doubling export earnings point to potential long-term balance-of-payments strengthening.
